match: Unable to connect to Deluge|Unable to retrieve queue and history items from Deluge
what: Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr could not reach Deluge
why: only a gap of 30+ minutes counts; short busy gaps flood the operator. Hold lifted 2026-11-16: 16 of the 21 short gaps in 7 days were during the old all-day Glacier run (11-15), none since it moved to 22:00; longest 15 min, so none would have been sent

what: Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr were refused by Deluge (password)
